teaser.en: Its wood is hard enough for bows, clubs and arrows, and soft enough to spin into fire by friction.
teaser.sw: Mbao zake ni ngumu kiasi cha kutengeneza pinde, marungu na mishale, na laini kiasi cha kupekecha moto kwa msuguano.
teaser.dg: Nyama za muhi uhu ni ngumu chiasi cha kuhenda maha, virungu na mivwi, na laini chiasi cha kuzunguluswa ili kuta moho.

summary.en: *Muhowe* is a coastal shrub or small tree with large yellow hibiscus-like flowers. Its hard, durable wood made bows, arrows, clubs, spoons and bowls, and its fruit and roots are also used.
summary.sw: *Muhowe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wa pwani wenye maua makubwa ya manjano yanayofanana na ya hibiscus. Mbao zake ngumu zinazodumu zilitengeneza pinde, mishale, marungu, vijiko na mabakuli, na matunda na mizizi yake pia hutumika.
summary.dg: *Muhowe* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wa pwani wenye maruwa makulu ga rangi ya mandano dza ga *hibiscus*. Nyama za muhi uhu ni ngumu na zinakaa sana, na kare zahumirwa kuhenda maha, mivwi, virungu, vidziko na mabakuli, na matunda na mizi piya nkuhumirwa.

about.en: *Muhowe* is a shrub or small tree, from 1 to 6 m tall, with broad heart-shaped leaves covered in tiny scales. Its flowers are large and yellow, shaped like a hibiscus, with a dark red centre. It belongs to the mallow family, alongside hibiscus, cotton and the portia tree of the beaches.
about.sw: *Muhowe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, wenye urefu wa m 1 hadi 6, wenye majani mapana yenye umbo la moyo yaliyofunikwa na magamba madogo sana. Maua yake ni makubwa na ya manjano, yenye umbo la ua la hibiscus, na kiini chekundu kilichokolea. Ni wa familia ya mibamia, pamoja na hibiscus, pamba na mtakawa wa fukweni.
about.dg: *Muhowe* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide, wa ure wa mita 1 hadi 6, wenye makodza mapana ga umbo ra moyo ganayofwinikpwa ni mamba madide sana. Maruwage ni makulu na ga rangi ya mandano, ga umbo dza ra *hibiscus*, na kahi-kahi ni ga kundu sana. Ni wa jamii ya *mallow*, phamwenga na *hibiscus*, pamba na *portia tree* ya pwani.

where.en: It grows in the coastal lowlands, in flood zones, along rivers, on forest margins and in bushland.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyanda za chini za pwani, maeneo yanayofurika maji, kando ya mito, pembezoni mwa misitu na katika nyika ya vichaka.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye tsi ya photsi ya pwani, phatu phanaphokala na mafuriko, kanda-kanda ya miho, kanda-kanda ya matsaka na weruni.

uses.en:
The wood is hard and durable. It is used to make clubs, bows and arrows, as well as spoons and bowls. The wood is also used to make fire by friction, spinning one stick against another until the dust smoulders.

The bark gives a fibre, the fruit is eaten, and the roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw:
Mbao zake ni ngumu na hudumu. Hutumika kutengeneza marungu, pinde na mishale, pamoja na vijiko na mabakuli. Mbao hizi pia hutumika kupekecha moto kwa msuguano, kwa kuzungusha kijiti kimoja dhidi ya kingine hadi unga wake uanze kufuka moshi.

Gamba hutoa nyuzi, tunda huliwa, na mizizi hutumika katika tiba za jadi.
uses.dg:
Nyama za muhi ni ngumu na zinakaa sana. Nkuhumirwa kuhenda virungu, maha na mivwi, na piya vidziko na mabakuli. Nyama za muhi piya nkuhumirwa kuta moho kpwa kuzungulusa chigongo chimwenga dzulu ya chanjina hadi vumbi riandze kulavya mosi.

Gopha rinalavya nyuzi, matunda nkuriwa, na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa za chienyeji.

names.en: The Digo name *muhowe* is shared with Giriama and Swahili; Swahili also has *muhonda*. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Thespesia danis*.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo *muhowe* linatumika pia kwa Kigiriama na Kiswahili; Kiswahili pia kina *muhonda*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Thespesia danis*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *muhowe* ni ra Chigiriama na Chiswahili piya; Chiswahili piya china *muhonda*. Takuna dzina ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Thespesia danis*.
